answer: For American Express (AMEX), a standard operating margin is not a useful or traditionally reported metric because, as a financial institution, its business model involves significant interest expense and credit loss provisions that are not categorized as operating expenses in the manner of non-financial corporations. Instead, AMEX's financial performance is evaluated using metrics like total revenues net of interest expense ($52,862 million for FY 2022), pretax income ($9,585 million for FY 2022), and net income ($7,514 million for FY 2022) [ch_290f30a8f788565c].
